title: benchmarks.py run SCENARIO --dry-run starts paid runs for every scenario but pool
goal: benchmarks.py run with --dry-run and a scenario other than pool (host-lookups, say) refuses with exit 2 naming the scenarios that have a plan, or prints that scenario's plan, and starts no claude -p run; today --dry-run is read only by bench_pool (b.dry), so run host-lookups --dry-run ran paid Sonnet sessions from the main checkout until the orchestrator of SP-x7ger6vu stopped it on 2026-10-09 (about 2 minutes of runs, no rows written). Merged from ST-o2jd35m2: the --kinds help text of benchmarks.py no longer says default all while --kinds all is refused as an unknown kind (it accepts all, or the help names the default as every kind), found by the SP-x7ger6vu review

run: import sys,os,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();os.environ['BENCH_SCRATCH']=d;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import benchmarks as b;hit=[];b.SCENARIOS['host-lookups']=('x',lambda bb:hit.append(1));r=b.main(['run','host-lookups','--dry-run','--out',d+'/o.csv']);sys.exit(0 if r==2 or not hit else 1)

repro_reason: running the behaviour starts paid claude -p sessions; the repro stubs the scenario and asks that --dry-run refuses it or never runs it

run: import subprocess,sys;h=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','run','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;k=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','run','pool','--kinds','all','--dry-run','--out','/dev/null'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if 'default: all' not in ' '.join(h.split()) or k.returncode==0 else 1)
